fullPassage: Coping with impulsivity is a more complicated ability than it appears, and for a long time we thought only humans could do it. If you put candy in front of a group of children and tell them that if they can resist eating it, they will eventually receive even more candy, a few interesting behaviors will follow. Some of the kids will try to distract themselves by playing with toys or drawing as a way to cope with the frustration of delaying gratification (some of the kids will just give up and grab the candy). This is quite advanced problem solving behavior, which is why it was surprising to find out that chimpanzees can do it, too. Researchers showed a group of chimps a small pile of candy that was accumulating more candy as time passed by, but the candy was inaccessible to them. Then they gave the chimps a set of toys. Every so often they would allow the chimps to have access to the candy. Several of the chimps caught on that the longer they waited, the more candy would accumulate, so they distracted themselves with the toys to avoid grabbing the candy until they could get a hefty amount. The chimps became intensely focused on the toys when the candy became accessible, showing that they really were diverting their attention so they could get a bigger reward later.

Every so often they would allow the chimps to have access to the candy. Several of the chimps caught on that the longer they waited, the more candy would accumulate, so they distracted themselves with the toys to avoid grabbing the candy until they could get a (C) [hefty / tiny] amount. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 아이들이 사탕을 먹는 것을 참으면(resist) 더 많은 사탕을 받을 수 있고, 침팬지도 이렇게 할 수 있다는 것이 놀라웠으며(surprising), 충분히 기다린 침팬지는 두둑한(hefty) 양의 사탕을 얻었다.
det.analysis:
① tolerate-surprising-hefty: tolerate(참다, 견디다)도 쓰일 수 있으나, 뒤에 '더 많은 사탕을 받게 된다'는 보상 조건과 자연스럽게 이어지려면 적극적으로 먹는 것을 '참는다'는 resist가 더 적절하므로 부적절❌
② resist-surprising-hefty: 세 낱말 모두 문맥상 적절함(아이들이 사탕 먹는 것을 참고, 침팬지도 할 수 있다는 것이 놀라웠고, 충분히 기다리면 두둑한 양을 얻는다는 흐름과 일치)✅
③ resist-expected-hefty: expected(예상된)는 '놀라웠다'는 surprising과 반대되는 의미라, 침팬지가 지연된 만족을 할 수 있다는 사실이 예상 밖이었다는 문맥과 어긋나 부적절❌
④ resist-surprising-tiny: tiny(아주 적은)는 충분히 기다려서 얻는 보상의 크기와 반대되는 의미라 부적절❌
det.tip: resist(참다) ↔ tolerate(버티다, 느낌이 다름), surprising(놀라운) ↔ expected(예상된), hefty(두둑한) ↔ tiny(아주 적은)

det.korean: 아이들은 장난감을 가지고 노는 것으로 좌절감에 대처하려 했고(cope with), 연구자들은 침팬지에게 사탕에 접근할 수 없게(inaccessible) 했으며, 침팬지는 기다려서 더 큰(bigger) 보상을 얻으려 했다.
